scientific limitations/integrity: The claimed theorem is an exact first-variation identity for smooth strictly convex radial perturbations of the centered unit sphere in R^3. It determines each fixed-offset harmonic kernel and establishes generic one-offset injectivity modulo first-harmonic translations; centered data lose all odd modes. It does not prove nonlinear recovery or stability. The closest later full manuscript was inspected; the earliest eligible preprint was accessible only by its abstract, so possible unindexed equivalent coverage remains a residual risk.
title: Exact one-offset linearized Archimedean tomography and its centered blind spot
